description: The kit's client health reports in Diagnostics: as admin, after health-missing-anchor.json and health-native.json on a fresh server process. GET /Bookmarks/Admin/Diagnostics lists the viewer's report (web 10.11.5) and viewer2's (web unknown, Jellyfin Media Player 1.12.0) and nothing forged; the report counts show the dropped ones (MaxEntries 200, none made room); the settings page's Diagnostics section shows both rows, written as text, and counts every dropped report in its summary.

steps.name: the viewer's report: detailButtons on details, web 10.11.5, required
steps.assert: __vars.diagnostics.ClientHealth.some(e => e.Anchor === 'detailButtons' && e.View === 'details' && e.WebVersion === '10.11.5' && e.Client === 'Jellyfin Web' && e.Required === true && e.Users === 1 && e.Reports === 1)

steps.name: viewer2's report: WebVersion null, Jellyfin Media Player 1.12.0
steps.assert: __vars.diagnostics.ClientHealth.some(e => e.Anchor === 'detailButtons' && e.WebVersion === null && e.Client === 'Jellyfin Media Player' && e.ClientVersion === '1.12.0')

steps.name: nothing forged was kept: two entries, both detailButtons on details
the counts: 2 accepted, 7 invalid (the Arabic-Indic digits too), 5 rate-limited, 1 too large, none from too many web clients, none made room
steps.assert: (r => r.Accepted === 2 && r.Invalid === 7 && r.RateLimited === 5 && r.TooLarge === 1 && r.TooManyWebClients === 0 && r.Overflow === 0 && r.Disabled === 0)(__vars.diagnostics.WebAnchors.Reports)

steps.name: the rest of the kit shape
steps.assert: (d => d.PluginVersion === '1.2.2.0' && d.Abi.Active === true && d.Store.Status && d.WebAnchors.Reporting === true && d.WebAnchors.Declared.includes('detailButtons') && d.WebAnchors.Problems.length === 0 && d.WebAnchors.MaxEntries === 200 && Array.isArray(d.Pages))(__vars.diagnostics)

steps.name: its Diagnostics section lists both reports
the summary counts every dropped report
steps.assert: __vars.summary.includes('Browser reports: recorded; 2 accepted, 13 dropped (invalid, too frequent, too many web clients for one user, too large or not recorded).')

steps.name: the list has room: no note that it is full
open the Diagnostics tab and scroll to it
no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag excepted)
